podcast.title: Considered the "GOAT" of Guitar Techs
podcast.body: Within the music business, Dallas Schoo is regarded by many as the "GOAT" (Greatest Of All Time) among guitar technicians, a testament to his skill and experience. "There are those in the business who consider him to be the goat of guitar techs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

podcast.title: Esteemed Guitar Tech
podcast.body: Dallas Schoo has an impressive resume as a guitar tech, having worked with a wide array of legendary artists including Bruce Springsteen, The Eagles, The Police, Pearl Jam, Prince, and U2. He is from Lexington, Kentucky. "Over here of Dallas Shoe, he's worked as a guitar tech for Bruce Springsteen, the Eagles, the police, Pearl Jam, Prince, and you two."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

podcast.title: Long-Term U2 Crew Member
podcast.body: Dallas Schoo has been a consistent member of U2's road crew since the second leg of The Joshua Tree tour, indicating a long and dedicated tenure with the band. "He's from Lexington, Kentucky and has been part of the you two road crew since the second leg of the Joshua Tree tour."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
